g.text: 25.2 The bar: 60% of the total, plus two overrides
a total on the line passes; a criterion at 1 still sends you back to the weakest two
below: the next two sessions focus on the weakest two criteria
override 1: any criterion at 1 sends you back, even above 60%
interview-ready: 4+ on every criterion, three mocks in a row
the bar is a floor for each mock, not a target for the whole course
non-AI mocks: seven criteria, 35 points; AI mocks: eight, 40 points
